Opposition Leaders Demand CEC Gyanesh Kumar's Removal

Opposition leaders have called for the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. P. Chidambaram criticized CEC Kumar over a "SIR U-Turn," stating he should be "surcharged." Akhilesh Yadav demanded CEC Gyanesh Kumar's removal and stated the BJP must admit its mistake.
